decision.summary: A sharp multi-axis displacement occurs around indices 630–632: E jumps up and sustains offset until ~640; U jumps up then descends slowly after ~635; N declines gradually without a matching step or return. No opposing return is observed for E within allowed context [590,670], and U’s descent starts later than the onset, lacking a clean reversal. Thus, only one uncertain temporary offset interval is identified.

The return in E is not observed within allowed context (ends at 670), and U’s descent begins only after 640—too late to confirm a paired temporary offset. Status: uncertain.
